verdict.rationale: This story asks whether the product acts as an MCP client or host that consumes tools from MCP servers. Auth0 is an identity and authorization platform, not an agent or host that runs tools, so the axis is a category error for this product. Its MCP-related material covers either the Auth0 MCP Server (the server role, not credited here) or securing customers' own agents when they connect to MCP servers. Neither shows Auth0 itself plugging in MCP servers to use their tools.
